platform.description: Post-rebrand Windows-checkout source contracts, rolled forward from 8cc68f5157e2408c49897488f6b2906d122567c5 after auditing every hunk of the issue #123 Win32 paste-path security change, and hashed after checkout normalization. The session artifact change is additive: the on-disk schema gains no field and loses none; parsing switched to alloc_always to stop restored strings aliasing a freed buffer, and validateAlloc now rejects control- or newline-bearing pane metadata, which the existing corrupt-state quarantine path handles.
